statement: There are 620 irreducible rational quartics through eleven general points.

answer.text: There are 620 irreducible rational quartics through eleven general points.
answer.qualification: Irreducible rational quartics through eleven general complex points; the 55 reducible curves in the auxiliary count 675 are excluded.

source.location: Theorem 1.1; Section 1.2, worked quartic example ending N_(4,3)=620; Section 1.4, displayed irreducible recursion

notes: Set d=4 and g=0, hence δ=3 nodes. The worked example in Section 1.2 subtracts the 55 reducible line-and-cubic curves from the auxiliary Severi degree 675, giving 675−55=620 irreducible rational quartics.
scope: Irreducible rational degree-4 plane curves through eleven general complex points.
